/**
 * Spike 0 harness prototype (T004, contracts/execution.md "Harness contract", "Mode isolation").
 *
 *   node scripts/spike-002/harness.ts check --config FILE
 *   node scripts/spike-002/harness.ts plan  --config FILE --role R --root DIR --attempt-id ID \
 *        --worktree DIR --git-dir DIR [--git-dir DIR] [--toolchain DIR]... [--prompt FILE]
 *   node scripts/spike-002/harness.ts run   <plan args> --ledger FILE [--allow-paid]
 *   node scripts/spike-002/harness.ts ledger --ledger FILE
 *
 * Everything vendor-specific (argv, settings, result location, model, effort) comes from an explicit
 * config. Nothing is inferred from help text or docs; capabilities stay `unknown` until a T006/T007
 * record proves them. claude/codex runs are paid: they require --allow-paid and reserve a slot in the
 * shared T001 ledger (6 invocations, 5 minutes each) before spawn, failures included.
 */
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  closeSync,
  copyFileSync,
  existsSync,
  fsyncSync,
  lstatSync,
  mkdirSync,
  openSync,
  readFileSync,
  realpathSync,
  unlinkSync,
  writeFileSync,
  writeSync,
  chmodSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, isAbsolute, join, normalize, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { hashCanonical } from '../../src/shared/hash.ts';
import { ROLE_SCHEMAS, isRole, roleJsonSchema, roleSchemaDigest, validateRoleResult, type Role, type ValidationIssue } from './role-schema.ts';
import { DEFAULT_LIMITS, SafeIdSchema, execOperation, prepareRunDir, writeAtomic, type ExitRecord, type RunSpec } from './runner.ts';
import { IN_SANDBOX, buildSandbox, sandboxCommand, type HostPolicy, defaultHostPolicy } from './sandbox.ts';

export const SPIKE_BUDGET = { max_invocations: 6, max_wall_ms: 5 * 60_000 } as const;

const CapabilityStatus = z.strictObject({
  status: z.enum(['proven', 'unproven', 'unknown']),
  evidence: z.string().nullable(),
});

export const CAPABILITIES = [
  'structured_output',
  'schema_acceptance_coder',
  'schema_acceptance_fixer',
  'schema_acceptance_reviewer',
  'native_inner_sandbox',
  'permission_denial_kept',
  'private_home_auth',
  'usage_report',
  'wall_limit',
  'cost_limit',
  'session_resume',
] as const;

export const HarnessConfigSchema = z.strictObject({
  schema_version: z.literal(1),
  vendor: z.enum(['claude', 'codex', 'fixture']),
  binary: z.strictObject({
    path: z.string(),
    /** Expected sha256 of the real binary file; mismatch refuses the plan. */
    sha256: z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/).nullable(),
    version_argv: z.array(z.string()).nullable(),
    expected_version: z.string().nullable(),
  }),
  /** Explicit, never defaulted. null model blocks claude/codex plans. */
  model: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
  effort: z.string().min(1).nullable(),
  /**
   * Placeholders: {model} {effort} {schema_file} {schema_inline} {output_file} {prompt_file}
   * {settings_file} {cwd}; an element that is exactly "{role_args}" expands to role_args[role].
   */
  argv: z.array(z.string()).min(1),
  role_args: z.partialRecord(z.enum(['coder', 'fixer', 'reviewer']), z.array(z.string())),
  prompt_via: z.enum(['stdin', 'argv']),
  result_source: z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('file') }),
    z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal('stdout_json'), pointer: z.array(z.string()) }),
  ]),
  settings: z.strictObject({ file_name: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/), content: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()) }).nullable(),
  auth_files: z.array(z.strictObject({ from: z.string(), to: z.string() })),
  isolation: z.strictObject({
    requested_inner_mode: z.enum(['internal_required', 'external_verified']),
    /** Trusted owner config, outside any repo. */
    owner_allows_external_verified: z.boolean(),
    native_result: z.enum(['not_run', 'passed', 'failed']),
    outer_proof_hash: z.string().nullable(),
    permission_policy_hash: z.string().nullable(),
  }),
  capabilities: z.partialRecord(z.enum(CAPABILITIES), CapabilityStatus),
  wall_ms: z.number().int().positive(),
  env: z.record(z.string(), z.string()),
});
export type HarnessConfig = z.infer<typeof HarnessConfigSchema>;

export type Readiness = { readonly ready: boolean; readonly blockers: readonly string[] };

const PLACEHOLDERS = ['model', 'effort', 'schema_file', 'schema_inline', 'output_file', 'prompt_file', 'settings_file', 'cwd', 'role_args'] as const;
type Placeholder = (typeof PLACEHOLDERS)[number];
const BYPASS = /dangerously|bypass|skip-permissions|accept-?all|yolo|ignore-?rules|no-?verify/i;
const INNER_OFF = /danger-full-access/i;

function strings(v: unknown): string[] {
  if (typeof v === 'string') return [v];
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.flatMap(strings);
  if (typeof v === 'object' && v !== null) return Object.entries(v).flatMap(([k, x]) => [k, ...strings(x)]);
  return [];
}

function innerSandboxOff(config: HarnessConfig): boolean {
  const sandbox = config.settings?.content['sandbox'];
  const settingsOff = typeof sandbox === 'object' && sandbox !== null && (sandbox as Record<string, unknown>)['enabled'] === false;
  return settingsOff || [...config.argv, ...strings(config.role_args)].some((a) => INNER_OFF.test(a));
}

/** Static policy checks; no process is spawned. */
export function checkConfig(config: HarnessConfig): Readiness {
  const blockers: string[] = [];
  const paid = config.vendor !== 'fixture';
  if (!isAbsolute(config.binary.path)) blockers.push('binary.path must be absolute');
  if (paid && config.model === null) blockers.push('model is not configured (never defaulted)');
  if (paid && config.binary.sha256 === null) blockers.push('binary.sha256 must be pinned');
  for (const s of [...config.argv, ...strings(config.role_args), ...strings(config.settings?.content ?? {})]) {
    if (BYPASS.test(s)) blockers.push(`permission bypass token rejected: ${s}`);
  }
  for (const a of config.argv) {
    for (const m of a.matchAll(/\{([a-z_]+)\}/g)) {
      if (!(PLACEHOLDERS as readonly string[]).includes(m[1] as string)) blockers.push(`unknown placeholder {${m[1]}}`);
    }
  }
  const uses = (p: Placeholder): boolean => config.argv.some((a) => a.includes(`{${p}}`));
  if (!uses('schema_file') && !uses('schema_inline')) blockers.push('argv does not pass {schema_file}: schema acceptance cannot be tested');
  if (config.result_source.kind === 'file' && !uses('output_file')) blockers.push('result_source=file but argv has no {output_file}');
  if (config.prompt_via === 'argv' && !uses('prompt_file')) blockers.push('prompt_via=argv but argv has no {prompt_file}');
  if (config.settings !== null && !uses('settings_file')) blockers.push('settings given but argv has no {settings_file}');
  if (config.wall_ms > SPIKE_BUDGET.max_wall_ms) blockers.push(`wall_ms exceeds spike cap ${SPIKE_BUDGET.max_wall_ms}`);
  for (const [name, c] of Object.entries(config.capabilities)) {
    if (c.status === 'proven' && c.evidence === null) blockers.push(`capability ${name} marked proven without evidence`);
  }
  for (const a of config.auth_files) {
    if (!isAbsolute(a.from)) blockers.push(`auth file ${a.from} must be absolute`);
    if (isAbsolute(a.to) || normalize(a.to).startsWith('..')) blockers.push(`auth target ${a.to} must stay inside the private home`);
  }
  for (const key of Object.keys(config.env)) {
    if (/(TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|API_KEY|CREDENTIAL)/i.test(key)) blockers.push(`env ${key}: auth must come from the private home, not env`);
  }

  const iso = config.isolation;
  const off = innerSandboxOff(config);
  if (iso.requested_inner_mode === 'internal_required' && off) blockers.push('inner sandbox disabled while internal_required');
  if (iso.requested_inner_mode === 'external_verified') {
    // ADR-0003: only after native was tried and failed, outer + permission proof exist, and the owner allowed it.
    if (!iso.owner_allows_external_verified) blockers.push('external_verified not allowed by owner config');
    if (iso.native_result !== 'failed') blockers.push('external_verified requires a recorded native failure');
    if (iso.outer_proof_hash === null) blockers.push('external_verified requires outer_proof_hash');
    if (iso.permission_policy_hash === null) blockers.push('external_verified requires permission_policy_hash');
    if (config.capabilities.permission_denial_kept?.status !== 'proven') blockers.push('external_verified requires proven permission_denial_kept');
  }
  return { ready: blockers.length === 0, blockers };
}

export function fileSha256(path: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex');
}

export type BinaryFacts = { readonly real_path: string; readonly sha256: string; readonly version: string | null; readonly issues: readonly string[] };

export function probeBinary(config: HarnessConfig): BinaryFacts {
  const issues: string[] = [];
  let real = config.binary.path;
  try {
    real = realpathSync(config.binary.path);
  } catch {
    return { real_path: real, sha256: '', version: null, issues: [`binary ${config.binary.path} not found`] };
  }
  const sha = fileSha256(real);
  if (config.binary.sha256 !== null && sha !== config.binary.sha256) issues.push(`binary sha256 ${sha} != pinned ${config.binary.sha256}`);
  let version: string | null = null;
  if (config.binary.version_argv !== null) {
    // Local version query only; never a model call.
    const r = spawnSync(real, config.binary.version_argv, { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 15_000, env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin' } });
    version = r.status === 0 ? r.stdout.trim() : null;
    if (version === null) issues.push('version probe failed');
  }
  if (config.binary.expected_version !== null && version !== null && !version.includes(config.binary.expected_version)) {
    issues.push(`version ${version} does not match pinned ${config.binary.expected_version}`);
  }
  return { real_path: real, sha256: sha, version, issues };
}

// --- plan ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type PlanInput = {
  readonly config: HarnessConfig;
  readonly role: Role;
  readonly root: string;
  readonly attemptId: string;
  readonly worktree: string;
  readonly gitDirs: readonly string[];
  readonly toolchain: readonly string[];
  readonly prompt: string;
  readonly hostPolicy?: HostPolicy;
};

export type HarnessPlan = {
  readonly readiness: Readiness;
  readonly paid: boolean;
  readonly run_dir: string;
  readonly files: { readonly schema: string; readonly prompt: string; readonly settings: string | null; readonly output: string };
  readonly harness_argv: readonly string[];
  readonly spec: RunSpec;
  readonly manifest: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const OUTPUT_NAME = 'final-response.json';

/** Claude 2.1.306 rejects the 2020-12 meta-schema. The portable body uses shared draft-7 keywords. */
function wireSchema(config: HarnessConfig, role: Role): Record<string, unknown> {
  const schema = roleJsonSchema(role);
  if (config.vendor === 'claude') delete schema['$schema'];
  return schema;
}

/** Builds the full plan. Creates the run directory skeleton but copies no auth and spawns nothing. */
export function planInvocation(input: PlanInput): HarnessPlan {
  const { config, role } = input;
  const checked = checkConfig(config);
  const binary = probeBinary(config);
  const blockers = [...checked.blockers, ...binary.issues];
  const attemptId = SafeIdSchema.parse(input.attemptId);
  const runDir = prepareRunDir(input.root, 'runs', attemptId);
  const dirs = { context: join(runDir, 'context'), schema: join(runDir, 'schema'), scratch: join(runDir, 'scratch'), home: join(runDir, 'private-home') };
  for (const d of Object.values(dirs)) mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });

  const schemaName = `${ROLE_SCHEMAS[role].id}.schema.json`;
  const inSandbox: Record<Exclude<Placeholder, 'role_args'>, string> = {
    model: config.model ?? '',
    effort: config.effort ?? '',
    schema_file: join(IN_SANDBOX.schema, schemaName),
    schema_inline: JSON.stringify(wireSchema(config, role)),
    output_file: join(IN_SANDBOX.scratch, OUTPUT_NAME),
    prompt_file: join(IN_SANDBOX.context, 'prompt.md'),
    settings_file: join(IN_SANDBOX.context, config.settings?.file_name ?? 'settings.json'),
    cwd: input.worktree,
  };
  if (config.effort === null && config.argv.some((a) => a.includes('{effort}'))) blockers.push('argv uses {effort} but effort is null');
  const harnessArgv = [
    binary.real_path,
    ...config.argv.flatMap((a) =>
      a === '{role_args}'
        ? (config.role_args[role] ?? [])
        : [a.replace(/\{([a-z_]+)\}/g, (_m, k: string) => inSandbox[k as keyof typeof inSandbox] ?? `{${k}}`)],
    ),
  ];

  const toolchain = [...new Set([dirname(binary.real_path), ...input.toolchain])];
  const sandbox = buildSandbox(
    {
      role,
      worktree: input.worktree,
      git_dirs: [...input.gitDirs],
      scratch: dirs.scratch,
      private_home: dirs.home,
      context: dirs.context,
      schema: dirs.schema,
      toolchain,
      env: { ...config.env, CUSR_ATTEMPT_ID: attemptId },
      network: 'internet_outbound',
    },
    input.hostPolicy ?? defaultHostPolicy([input.root.endsWith('/') ? input.root.slice(0, -1) : input.root].map((r) => join(r, 'cusr.db'))),
  );

  const files = {
    schema: join(dirs.schema, schemaName),
    prompt: join(dirs.context, 'prompt.md'),
    settings: config.settings === null ? null : join(dirs.context, config.settings.file_name),
    output: join(dirs.scratch, OUTPUT_NAME),
  };
  const operationId = `op-${attemptId}`;
  const spec: RunSpec = {
    schema_version: 1,
    kind: 'runs',
    operation_id: operationId,
    attempt_id: attemptId,
    command: sandboxCommand(sandbox, harnessArgv),
    cwd: input.worktree,
    env: {},
    stdin_file: config.prompt_via === 'stdin' ? files.prompt : null,
    deadline_ms: Math.min(config.wall_ms, SPIKE_BUDGET.max_wall_ms),
    redact_files: config.auth_files.map((a) => a.from),
    binding: {
      vendor: config.vendor,
      model: config.model,
      effort: config.effort,
      role,
      schema_id: ROLE_SCHEMAS[role].id,
      schema_digest: roleSchemaDigest(role),
      binary_sha256: binary.sha256,
      binary_version: binary.version,
      selected_inner_mode: config.isolation.requested_inner_mode,
    },
    limits: {},
  };

  const manifest = {
    schema_version: 1,
    proven: false,
    vendor: config.vendor,
    binary: { path: config.binary.path, real_path: binary.real_path, sha256: binary.sha256, version: binary.version },
    model: config.model,
    effort: config.effort,
    argv_template_hash: hashCanonical({ argv: config.argv, role_args: config.role_args }),
    settings_hash: config.settings === null ? null : hashCanonical(config.settings.content),
    result_source: config.result_source,
    schema: { role, id: ROLE_SCHEMAS[role].id, digest: roleSchemaDigest(role), wire_digest: hashCanonical(wireSchema(config, role)) },
    isolation: {
      native_result: config.isolation.native_result,
      selected_inner_mode: config.isolation.requested_inner_mode,
      inner_sandbox_off: innerSandboxOff(config),
      outer_proof_hash: config.isolation.outer_proof_hash,
      permission_policy_hash: config.isolation.permission_policy_hash,
      layout_digest: sandbox.layout_digest,
      network: sandbox.network,
    },
    capabilities: Object.fromEntries(CAPABILITIES.map((c) => [c, config.capabilities[c] ?? { status: 'unknown', evidence: null }])),
  };

  return {
    readiness: { ready: blockers.length === 0, blockers },
    paid: config.vendor !== 'fixture',
    run_dir: runDir,
    files,
    harness_argv: harnessArgv,
    spec,
    manifest,
  };
}

/** Writes schema/prompt/settings read-only and copies only the selected auth files (0600) into the private home. */
export function materialize(plan: HarnessPlan, config: HarnessConfig, role: Role, prompt: string): void {
  writeFileSync(plan.files.schema, `${JSON.stringify(wireSchema(config, role), null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o400, flag: 'wx' });
  writeFileSync(plan.files.prompt, prompt, { mode: 0o400, flag: 'wx' });
  if (config.settings !== null && plan.files.settings !== null) {
    writeFileSync(plan.files.settings, `${JSON.stringify(config.settings.content, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o400, flag: 'wx' });
  }
  const home = join(plan.run_dir, 'private-home');
  for (const a of config.auth_files) {
    const st = lstatSync(a.from);
    if (!st.isFile()) throw new Error(`auth file ${a.from} must be a regular file (symlinks refused)`);
    const target = join(home, a.to);
    mkdirSync(dirname(target), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    copyFileSync(a.from, target);
    chmodSync(target, 0o600);
  }
}

// --- budget ledger ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

export type LedgerEntry = {
  readonly seq: number;
  readonly at: string;
  readonly attempt_id: string;
  readonly vendor: string;
  readonly role: string;
  readonly wall_cap_ms: number;
  readonly event: 'reserved' | 'finished';
  readonly outcome: string | null;
  readonly approved_max_invocations?: number;
};

export function readLedger(path: string): LedgerEntry[] {
  if (!existsSync(path)) return [];
  return readFileSync(path, 'utf8')
    .split('\n')
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((l) => JSON.parse(l) as LedgerEntry);
}

function appendDurable(path: string, line: string): void {
  const fd = openSync(path, 'a', 0o600);
  try {
    writeSync(fd, line);
    fsyncSync(fd);
  } finally {
    closeSync(fd);
  }
}

function withLedgerLock<T>(path: string, fn: () => T): T {
  const lock = `${path}.lock`;
  let fd: number;
  try {
    fd = openSync(lock, 'wx', 0o600);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`ledger ${path} is locked by another invocation (${lock})`);
  }
  try {
    return fn();
  } finally {
    closeSync(fd);
    unlinkSync(lock);
  }
}

/** Reserves one paid invocation before spawn. Every reservation counts, whatever the outcome. */
export function reserveBudget(path: string, attemptId: string, vendor: string, role: string, wallMs: number, maxInvocations: number = SPIKE_BUDGET.max_invocations): LedgerEntry {
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(maxInvocations) || maxInvocations < 1) throw new Error('approved invocation limit must be a positive safe integer');
  return withLedgerLock(path, () => {
    const entries = readLedger(path);
    const reserved = entries.filter((e) => e.event === 'reserved');
    if (reserved.length >= maxInvocations) {
      throw new Error(`spike budget exhausted: ${reserved.length}/${maxInvocations} invocations already reserved; ask the owner before more`);
    }
    if (reserved.some((e) => e.attempt_id === attemptId)) throw new Error(`attempt ${attemptId} already reserved`);
    if (wallMs > SPIKE_BUDGET.max_wall_ms) throw new Error('wall cap exceeds 5 minutes');
    const entry: LedgerEntry = { seq: entries.length, at: new Date().toISOString(), attempt_id: attemptId, vendor, role, wall_cap_ms: wallMs, event: 'reserved', outcome: null,
      ...(maxInvocations !== SPIKE_BUDGET.max_invocations ? { approved_max_invocations: maxInvocations } : {}) };
    appendDurable(path, `${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`);
    return entry;
  });
}

export function recordFinished(path: string, attemptId: string, vendor: string, role: string, outcome: string): void {
  withLedgerLock(path, () => {
    const seq = readLedger(path).length;
    const entry: LedgerEntry = { seq, at: new Date().toISOString(), attempt_id: attemptId, vendor, role, wall_cap_ms: 0, event: 'finished', outcome };
    appendDurable(path, `${JSON.stringify(entry)}\n`);
  });
}

// --- result normalisation -----------------------------------------------------------------------

export type NormalizedStatus = 'valid' | 'invalid_output' | 'process_failed' | 'timeout' | 'missing_output';

export type NormalizedResult = {
  readonly status: NormalizedStatus;
  readonly role: Role;
  readonly issues: readonly ValidationIssue[] | readonly string[];
  readonly raw_digest: string | null;
  readonly result_path: string | null;
};

function readStdoutJson(runDir: string, pointer: readonly string[]): { value: unknown; raw: string } | null {
  const path = join(runDir, 'events.jsonl');
  if (!existsSync(path)) return null;
  const lines = readFileSync(path, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
  const last = lines.at(-1);
  if (last === undefined) return null;
  const rec = JSON.parse(last) as { data: unknown; truncated?: boolean };
  if (rec.truncated === true) return null;
  let v: unknown = rec.data;
  for (const k of pointer) v = typeof v === 'object' && v !== null ? (v as Record<string, unknown>)[k] : undefined;
  return v === undefined ? null : { value: typeof v === 'string' ? tryParse(v) : v, raw: JSON.stringify(rec.data) };
}

function tryParse(s: string): unknown {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(s) as unknown;
  } catch {
    return s;
  }
}

/**
 * Orchestrator-side validation: exit facts, freshness of the per-attempt output path, size, schema,
 * semantics; then writes out/result.json with provenance taken from runner files, not from the model.
 */
export function normalizeResult(plan: HarnessPlan, config: HarnessConfig, role: Role, exit: ExitRecord, outputPreexisted: boolean): NormalizedResult {
  const base = { role, raw_digest: null, result_path: null };
  if (exit.outcome === 'timeout') return { ...base, status: 'timeout', issues: ['deadline reached'] };
  let raw: string;
  let value: unknown;
  if (config.result_source.kind === 'file') {
    if (outputPreexisted) return { ...base, status: 'invalid_output', issues: ['output path existed before launch (stale result)'] };
    if (!existsSync(plan.files.output)) return { ...base, status: exit.outcome === 'exited' && exit.exit_code === 0 ? 'missing_output' : 'process_failed', issues: ['no output file'] };
    const st = lstatSync(plan.files.output);
    if (!st.isFile()) return { ...base, status: 'invalid_output', issues: ['output is not a regular file'] };
    if (st.size > DEFAULT_LIMITS.result_bytes) return { ...base, status: 'invalid_output', issues: ['output exceeds 1 MiB'] };
    if (st.mtimeMs < Date.parse(exit.started_at) - 1_000) return { ...base, status: 'invalid_output', issues: ['output older than launch'] };
    raw = readFileSync(plan.files.output, 'utf8');
    value = tryParse(raw);
  } else {
    const got = readStdoutJson(plan.run_dir, config.result_source.pointer);
    if (got === null) return { ...base, status: exit.outcome === 'exited' && exit.exit_code === 0 ? 'missing_output' : 'process_failed', issues: ['no complete final stdout record'] };
    raw = got.raw;
    value = got.value;
  }
  const digest = `sha256:${createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex')}`;
  const validation = validateRoleResult(role, value);
  if (exit.outcome !== 'exited' || exit.exit_code !== 0) {
    // A schema-valid answer from a failed process is never accepted as done.
    return { role, status: 'process_failed', issues: [`outcome ${exit.outcome} exit ${String(exit.exit_code)}`], raw_digest: digest, result_path: null };
  }
  if (!validation.ok) return { role, status: 'invalid_output', issues: validation.issues, raw_digest: digest, result_path: null };
  const out = {
    schema_version: 1,
    provenance: {
      operation_id: exit.operation_id,
      attempt_id: exit.attempt_id,
      launch_nonce: exit.launch_nonce,
      role,
      schema_id: ROLE_SCHEMAS[role].id,
      schema_digest: roleSchemaDigest(role),
      vendor: config.vendor,
      model: config.model,
      effort: config.effort,
      binary_sha256: plan.manifest['binary'] !== undefined ? (plan.manifest['binary'] as { sha256: string }).sha256 : null,
      source: config.result_source.kind,
      raw_digest: digest,
      usage: exit.usage,
    },
    value: validation.value,
  };
  const outDir = join(plan.run_dir, 'out');
  writeAtomic(outDir, 'result.json', `${JSON.stringify(out)}\n`);
  return { role, status: 'valid', issues: [], raw_digest: digest, result_path: join(outDir, 'result.json') };
}

export type RunOutcome = { readonly plan: HarnessPlan; readonly exit: ExitRecord | null; readonly result: NormalizedResult | null; readonly refused: string | null };

/** plan → (paid guard + ledger reservation) → materialize → runner exec → normalize. */
export async function runInvocation(input: PlanInput, opts: { ledger: string; allowPaid: boolean; maxInvocations?: number }): Promise<RunOutcome> {
  const plan = planInvocation(input);
  if (!plan.readiness.ready) return { plan, exit: null, result: null, refused: `not ready: ${plan.readiness.blockers.join('; ')}` };
  if (plan.paid && !opts.allowPaid) return { plan, exit: null, result: null, refused: 'paid vendor requires --allow-paid' };
  if (existsSync(join(plan.run_dir, 'launch.json'))) return { plan, exit: null, result: null, refused: 'attempt already launched; use runner receipt' };
  // Only paid vendors consume the shared spike budget; the local fixture vendor never does.
  if (plan.paid) reserveBudget(opts.ledger, input.attemptId, input.config.vendor, input.role, plan.spec.deadline_ms, opts.maxInvocations);
  let outcome = 'unknown';
  try {
    materialize(plan, input.config, input.role, input.prompt);
    const outputPreexisted = existsSync(plan.files.output);
    const r = await execOperation(plan.spec, input.root);
    if (r.status === 'marker_exists') {
      outcome = 'marker_exists';
      return { plan, exit: null, result: null, refused: 'launch marker exists; not respawning' };
    }
    const result = normalizeResult(plan, input.config, input.role, r.exit, outputPreexisted);
    outcome = `${r.exit.outcome}/${result.status}`;
    return { plan, exit: r.exit, result, refused: null };
  } finally {
    if (plan.paid) recordFinished(opts.ledger, input.attemptId, input.config.vendor, input.role, outcome);
  }
}

// --- cli ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function loadConfig(file: string): HarnessConfig {
  return HarnessConfigSchema.parse(JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(file), 'utf8')));
}

function main(argv: readonly string[]): Promise<number> | number {
  const [cmd, ...rest] = argv;
  const opt = (name: string): string | undefined => {
    const i = rest.indexOf(name);
    return i >= 0 ? rest[i + 1] : undefined;
  };
  const many = (name: string): string[] => rest.flatMap((a, i) => (a === name && rest[i + 1] !== undefined ? [resolve(rest[i + 1] as string)] : []));
  const out = (v: unknown): void => void process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(v, null, 2)}\n`);
  const configFile = opt('--config');
  if (cmd === 'ledger') {
    const ledger = opt('--ledger');
    if (ledger === undefined) return usage();
    const entries = readLedger(resolve(ledger));
    out({ budget: SPIKE_BUDGET, approved_max_invocations: Math.max(SPIKE_BUDGET.max_invocations, ...entries.map((e) => e.approved_max_invocations ?? 0)), reserved: entries.filter((e) => e.event === 'reserved').length, entries });
    return 0;
  }
  if (configFile === undefined) return usage();
  const config = loadConfig(configFile);
  if (cmd === 'check') {
    const readiness = checkConfig(config);
    out({ readiness, binary: probeBinary(config) });
    return readiness.ready ? 0 : 1;
  }
  const role = opt('--role');
  const root = opt('--root');
  const attemptId = opt('--attempt-id');
  const worktree = opt('--worktree');
  if (role === undefined || !isRole(role) || root === undefined || attemptId === undefined || worktree === undefined) return usage();
  const promptFile = opt('--prompt');
  const input: PlanInput = {
    config,
    role,
    root: resolve(root),
    attemptId,
    worktree: resolve(worktree),
    gitDirs: many('--git-dir'),
    toolchain: many('--toolchain'),
    prompt: promptFile === undefined ? '' : readFileSync(resolve(promptFile), 'utf8'),
  };
  if (cmd === 'plan') {
    const plan = planInvocation(input);
    out(plan);
    return plan.readiness.ready ? 0 : 1;
  }
  if (cmd === 'run') {
    const ledger = opt('--ledger');
    if (ledger === undefined) return usage();
    if (promptFile === undefined) return usage();
    const max = opt('--max-invocations');
    return runInvocation(input, { ledger: resolve(ledger), allowPaid: rest.includes('--allow-paid'), ...(max === undefined ? {} : { maxInvocations: Number(max) }) }).then((r) => {
      out({ refused: r.refused, exit: r.exit, result: r.result, manifest: r.plan.manifest });
      return r.result?.status === 'valid' ? 0 : 1;
    });
  }
  return usage();
}

function usage(): number {
  process.stderr.write(
    'usage: harness.ts check --config FILE | plan|run --config FILE --role coder|fixer|reviewer --root DIR --attempt-id ID --worktree DIR [--git-dir DIR]... [--toolchain DIR]... [--prompt FILE] [--ledger FILE --allow-paid [--max-invocations OWNER_APPROVED_TOTAL]] | ledger --ledger FILE\n',
  );
  return 2;
}

if (process.argv[1] !== undefined && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  Promise.resolve()
    .then(() => main(process.argv.slice(2)))
    .then((code) => {
      process.exitCode = code;
    })
    .catch((e: unknown) => {
      process.stderr.write(`${e instanceof Error ? `${e.name}: ${e.message}` : String(e)}\n`);
      process.exitCode = 2;
    });
}
